## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] I looked at the affected slides in `demo/demo.pdf`.
- [ ] The README and docs are updated if commands, options or behaviour changed.
- [ ] User-visible changes are listed under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Colour or branding changes cite a source in `docs/branding.md`.
- [ ] No compiled PDFs, logo files, private content or unlicensed third-party files are added.
